questions.q: Where is a Power BI data alert's threshold actually configured?
options: In Power Automate, as a trigger condition
In Power BI itself, on the tile, before any flow exists
In Microsoft Teams, as a channel rule
In SharePoint, as a list column rule
questions.explain: The data alert and its threshold are set directly on the Power BI tile. Power Automate only reacts to it afterward, through the data-alert trigger.

questions.q: What is the one required field on the "When a data driven alert is triggered" trigger?
options: Workspace ID
Dataset name
Alert ID
Tile URL
questions.explain: Alert ID identifies which specific Power BI data alert the trigger listens for — it's the trigger's only required field.

questions.q: Why can't a flow reliably know a Power BI dataset refresh has finished just from the "Refresh a dataset" action's result?
options: The action is deprecated and no longer works
The action only confirms the refresh request was accepted, not that the refresh completed
Dataset refreshes cannot be triggered from Power Automate at all
The action always returns a failure status by design
questions.explain: "Refresh a dataset" reports that the request was accepted, not the eventual outcome. Getting the real result requires a delay plus a check of the refresh history.

questions.q: Which Power BI refresh scenario has a dedicated completion trigger in Power Automate?
options: Dataset refresh
Dataflow refresh
Report refresh
Workspace refresh
questions.explain: "When a dataflow refresh completes" is a real trigger that reports success or failure directly. No equivalent trigger exists for dataset refresh completion.

questions.q: Castlebridge Logistics wants the fastest possible setup for emailing the ops team when its on-time-delivery alert fires. What should it use?
options: Build a flow entirely from scratch using the HTTP connector
Use the ready-made template that emails any audience when a Power BI data alert is triggered
Write a custom connector
Poll the dataset every minute with a Recurrence trigger
questions.explain: The template already wires the data-alert trigger to an Outlook send-email action — the fastest path when the scenario matches a common one like this.
